image_description: A wide shot of a theatrical stage performance featuring seven individuals in elaborate, fantasy-style costumes (resembling anime or game characters). They are standing on an elevated platform with a dark floor. Above them is a complex metal truss system with stage lighting fixtures emitting blue and white light. The background is dark, typical of a theater interior. In the foreground, there is a blurred area that appears to be the audience or floor level below the stage.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. If the text is completely illegible or nonsensical, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, scrutinize the hands of the performers; AI often struggles with finger counts in complex gestures. Check if the lighting on the faces matches the direction of the overhead rig.
